articles.title: Stablecoins retain the edge over tokenized money market funds, JPMorgan says
articles.snippet: The bank said tokenized money market funds account for only about 5% of the broader stablecoin universe despite offering yield.

articles.title: US sanctions Sinaloa cartel-linked Ethereum addresses
articles.snippet: OFAC sanctioned six Ethereum addresses linked to a Sinaloa Cartel money laundering network allegedly converting drug proceeds into crypto.

articles.title: Bitcoin’s ‘less aggressive demand’ may lead to months of consolidation: Analysis
articles.snippet: Bitcoin demand and ETF flows weaken as BTC struggles below $80,000, raising risks of prolonged consolidation or a drop toward $65,000.

articles.title: SEC seeks public comment as it weighs prediction market ETFs
articles.snippet: Bitwise, Roundhill Investments and GraniteShares had their prediction market ETF applications put on hold by the SEC earlier this month.

articles.title: SpaceX reveals larger-than-expected Bitcoin holdings in IPO filing
articles.snippet: SpaceX is expected to go public next month, which would make its 18,712 Bitcoin holdings rank seventh among public companies.
